problem_type: Concurrent validation saturates a shared workstation
symptom: Worktrees running gates concurrently hang tests and cause false visual failures.
direct_cause: Independent npm entrypoints spawn heavyweight suites with no machine-wide admission lock.
class_root: Validation execution has no shared resource owner across worktrees and nested entrypoints.
affected_population: All local gates, contracts, test-system and walkthrough npm callers
entry_points: test-system and direct walkthrough npm scripts

external_sources.purpose: Native flock acquisition and descriptor lifetime

invariants: At most one independent validation command owns the machine lock; nested commands reuse verified owner identity.
The kernel releases dead descriptors, and a live inherited child prevents premature takeover.
generality_proof: Every resource-consuming npm entry wraps the same OS lock inode. OS atomic acquisition spans worktrees; nested owner identity avoids self-deadlock.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Serialize command admission and preserve exit/cancellation semantics.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both entrypoints execute with-gates-lock.py; nested contracts inherit token.
All declared heavyweight npm entrypoints wrap the same native lock.

recurrence.reason: Any two worktrees can otherwise concurrently start the same heavyweight suites.
same_class_scan: Inspected package.json gates, contracts, direct UX, test-system and design-lab walk entrypoints.
Inspected run-gates-contracts.mjs and test-system.mjs nested pnpm execution.

prevention.invariant: Independent validation commands serialize on a fixed machine-wide OS lock.
prevention.failure_mode: Lock contention waits with owner diagnostics; lock API failures exit nonzero before spawning work.
prevention.strategy: Use stdlib OS locking rather than PID-file reclamation, retaining the inode and inheriting the descriptor.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaced unguarded npm commands in place; no alternate unlocked npm commands.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing Python standard library and native OS locking; installs no package.

migration: No user-data migration. The stable tmp lock inode is retained; stale metadata is overwritten only after the kernel grants ownership.
residual_risks: Direct ad-hoc commands and worktrees without this change do not participate.
Windows msvcrt behavior is implemented but only POSIX locking was exercised on this host.
